reviews.text:
I have no complaint about the care of my dog. The communication is another matter.

Today At around 6 in the morning I received a message saying “Call me immediately,” with no explanation. No Hi, nothing. My answer was “who are you?” and she typed “I am the owner of buldog hotel.

As a dog owner abroad, my first thought was obviously that something had happened to my dog. It had not. I was told that they were full, that this is not a long-term boarding facility, and that I had to collect my dog within today…

Giving a month-long, regularly paying customer an alarming dawn message and a same day notice is not professional. You know how Bobby is calm and friendly dog. And you knew residence permit and official process is always slow in Hungary and not under my control. And I don’t have anybody to take care of him in there. This process was already heavy and you made it more heavier. Thanks. This behaviour was not deserved by me and my dog.

I've been bringing my blog here for years
I recommend it to everyone
With a huge play area and indoor relaxation area. The girls are nice!

Dear Boldoghotel!
We have been coming to you for 2 years now and we are very satisfied! Cuki always comes home happy and smells good. We always look at the stories posted and it is nice to see that Cuki is happily running around with his friends and feeling good🥰
We thank you very much for being able to count on you and for always waiting for Cuki with great pleasure🫶🏼💖
Thank you for your work.
Have a nice day💖

We just had a trial day and we are extremely satisfied with the dog boarding! From the very first moment, the high level of expertise, care and true love for animals was evident. Our dog was calm, balanced, and it was clear that he was safe and in good hands.

Clean, tidy place, with reliable and experienced professionals. If you are looking for a professional dog boarding with loving treatment and high level of expertise, I can only recommend it!

We have already bought a pass for the dog several times and we take him here and to Kamaraerdő. The dog loves it when we take him, he always runs in. By the evening he is well tired from running around all day with his friends.

I am very grateful that such a safe and dedicated place for dogs exists. It is much more than a daycare and a hotel. Whether we take our dog to daycare for a day or for several days, it is in a caring and loving environment. We have been so happy that our dog asked for more attention, and was given efficient and professional care. It is very, very good that you are here, thank you very much. The dog is really happy with you.

I would like to share my opinion about the place..
My dog ​​spent 6 days at the guesthouse. In the videos shared on Facebook stories, he really seemed happy, but these were only short moments of the day.
When I went to pick him up, he had a strong smell, looked worn out, and was wearing a collar that wasn't ours. I have to say that it didn't belong to us.
The collar was also so tight that it surprised me.
I don't understand why a collar is necessary in a guesthouse where dogs are supposed to be free to move around all day. I brought his own bed, plus a blanket, but it still smelled bad, + I got it back full of other dogs' hair.
He lost a lot of weight in six days. I accept that he was moving a lot, but losing that much weight is excessive. He is also currently having problems with his stools...he has difficulty emptying his bowels. He probably hasn't been drinking enough. His eyes are red and itchy, which is probably inflammation.

I will definitely not take him here again!
Incredibly kind and knowledgeable staff. I'm sorry that I've been taking my dog ​​there less lately, through my own fault, because he loves it there. I can only recommend them!

A fantastic team who work with great expertise! Since we moved, our dog has been brutally beautiful, we can't leave him alone at all. But at Bolgodokhotel, he has felt good since the first time. He can run around in a huge area and play with other dogs, even though they are in a frequented place, not on the outskirts of the city. Plus, you can count on them in rain, snow, weekends, and holidays, and they always keep the dogs in good conditions and safe. They really are the best! 🥰

It's a really great place, our not-so-simple little dog loves it too, he gets loving treatment that suits his temperament, they pay attention to his needs, they slowly got him used to the others. Thanks to Emese and Saci, Eszti and the others who take care of him responsibly and lovingly while we're not home.

With my previous puppy Lakat, I met Lidi, the owner and professional manager of Boldoghotel, about 12 years ago, who was one of the leading instructors at the Tükör Methodical Dog School together with her partner, Balázz. Even then, she was completely fascinated by the fact that it was possible to train dogs like this, without constant torture. At that time, the family's favorite was an adopted terrier mix, with all the tough qualities that come with the breed. Thanks to the school and their expertise, our days were enriched with a great, cooperative terrier in a few weeks.
Shortly after finishing school, Lidi also started working in a dog daycare. At that time, she was still without a location, only with the dogs they trained, and she went to the exercise circles with a couple of colleagues who were also dog trainers at various approved dog walking locations.
There was no question that Lakat would join the team twice a week. We were constant fans of this fantastic pack for more than 8 years.
Lakat finally got old and Lidi and I discussed that this stimulus was too much for him, he gets tired quickly, he gets annoyed by the many young people, he needs to retire to a calm retirement environment. Last year, unfortunately, I lost my puppy. :(
This year, however, a new arrival arrived, an Airedale Terrier who is also "I will try everything for my owner". There was no question that in addition to the puppy's school, I would take the little terrorist to daycare as much as possible. :) It seems that my currently 7.5-month-old adolescent dog can also function if he gets the necessary exercise and brain training! :) :)

Thank you for being there!!!!
Without any bias, based solely on my experiences, I can only recommend the BolgodHotel team to everyone!!!!
Bonzo's favorite place after home! :) We love going here, everyone is nice, they pay attention to everything and most importantly, we always get a tired happy dog ​​back! :D

Extremely kind and helpful team!
Mia loves going there and I am calm because she is safe! <3

I finally found the perfect dog boarding house! 🙏🏻

I have been looking for a long time for a place where dogs are truly treated with expertise, attention and love, I have looked at many dog ​​boarding houses and finally I have found it! 🙂
Here they pay maximum attention not only to the needs of the dogs, but also to the needs of the owners, which gives me great peace of mind.
My dog, true to the name of the place, always arrives happy and it is obvious that he feels good while he is there. I can follow this myself through the continuous photo and video sharing.
The boarding house team is extremely professional, kind and pays attention to every detail: safety, play, daily routine, personalized care during the boarding house.
I wholeheartedly recommend it to everyone who is looking for a place where dogs are truly treated as family members. 🐕 ❤️
Totalitarians
They are very flexible and kind, my puppy usually doesn't want to come home.

We've only been there twice, but the first time I really liked the place, not only me, but my little dog too. In the previous daycare we went to, he always cried after me for the first fifteen minutes, here he happily goes to play. Fantastic place, I highly recommend it to everyone :)
My dog's paradise :)

It is very rare to find a place where we can feel our dog is completely safe, while still looking forward to the days spent there. For which I would like to thank you very much, because every new dog that arrives goes through a screening process, where they assess whether it can be safely allowed into the already established community. If necessary, they treat it separately, help with its socialization, and only then allow it to join the other dogs. If they feel it is not safe, they do not do it. This is why I can feel safe with my dog ​​every time, which is very important to me. In addition, it plays a lot and thus tires itself out properly, which is also important for a vizsla, especially.
Thank you very much for your work!

Best of dog boarding, ever 😍
Every single person working there is professional, my dogs love boarding/daycare, they pay close attention to every little movement of all the dogs, they know “dogs” and if I have any problems, they help me right away. When they give me feedback about my dogs’ behavior, they always do it for the sake of the dog park-for-us-and-our relationship. I have recommended them to many of my dog-loving friends and will continue to do so in the future ❤️ (If I could give them 10 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️, they really deserve it!)
A family environment where they love my dog ​​and actively take care of him. I can only recommend it.
I can only recommend it! WOW

I can only speak in superlatives about the daycare and the boarding house, we have been to many places. We go there weekly with a really difficult to handle Vizsla, and what we get and what they give us there is worth everything. Not only does our dog come home tired, and we see that he had a good time, but they pay attention to what kind of problem we go to them with and what they need to pay close attention to. I would actually say that it is not just a dog socialization play area, but a company of expert people whose whole thing is to nurture the relationship between the dog and the owner.
❤️❤️❤️
Bruno has been a regular here since it opened. He loves coming here. Happy dog ​​❤️🐶🐾🐾 …
The best place for your best friend 🥰 …
I always know that he is safe, I always know that daycare is a happy day. For 9 years, my furry child and I have received love, professional knowledge, and care. I am grateful!

I love this place. My dog ​​has known the girls who run it for 4 years and we can always count on them for everything! I recommend it to all dog owners with a warm heart because here I am sure that our little family member is safe and in a good place! Thank you for being there! Keep it up! ❤️
Our dog Zelda loves going here, so we can travel with peace of mind. They are very reliable, we go to their other location twice a week. They are the best in town.
Great team, I highly recommend them. They have been taking care of our dog for years when we are away.
Great place! Blanca loves it and it's a great help to us. Keep it up!!!🤩👍 …

The best dog daycare and boarding house🧡
A truly skilled, professional and kind team! My vizsla loves going there 🥰 and I can see why in the videos uploaded during the day😌Great place😍Thank you for being there! …
We always bring our dog Artúr here with a good heart. He feels good, and we know he is safe. Great environment, attentive team, wonderful dog friends.
They are kind and helpful, our dog goes there happily every time, so we warmly recommend them to everyone! :)

We met Lidi back in the day at the dog school as an instructor, 5 years ago now. Back then, we didn't know that dog daycare existed ☺️
There was no question that we would try it at Boldoghotel. The huge area, the expert team, who we could always turn to with questions, was a great experience from the start. The continuous supervision and feedback, both verbally and in photos and videos, is reassuring. Since then, we have been taking Polli there weekly, winter and summer, and she always arrives with a happy wave. 🐾
The happiest dogs and owners are here ♥️
Very kind, extreme professionalism, highly recommended!

Great place! We leave our dog here with the utmost safety and peace of mind, whether for 1 day or 1 week. The place in Kamaraerdei and Kondorfa Street are also wonderful. Our dog has been going since he was 4 months old, he loves it and has learned to communicate with other dogs fantastically, he is now 4 years old. We know Pufi is always completely safe, in both Boldoghotel daycare centers!
My dog ​​has been with them since he was a puppy. I can thank the staff here a lot for making sure I have a well-socialized adult dog. I can only recommend them!

All our socialized dogs are welcome to come, including our friends' dogs and our acquaintances' dogs. Thank you for letting them party safely while we work. The story is great. We can follow the events in advance. Oh... and we have a dog who is not there, of course we house him and for the sake of all the other dogs we don't try to bring him in. Live and let live. Thank you for regulating who can go out and who can't, so the "kids" can play in peace.
We've been going to them for 8 and a half years, it's Mira's second home, with great caretakers 🙂 …

One of the most reliable and professional teams, to whom I can trust our dog with peace of mind. They pay close attention to the dog's habits and needs and place him in the right team accordingly. My vizsla is now a little retired, he needs a lot more rest than he used to. He also needs to take medication, and they can pay maximum attention to this. Alfi loves being there. I am grateful to the whole team! <3

Jack and I have been going to Boldoghotel for over five years. Anyone who has a dog knows how important it is for your dog to be in good hands and feel comfortable. They always pay attention to it and take care of it. I am very grateful to Lidi and her team for having such a reliable place. Thank you for your work!
I can only recommend it to everyone. Everyone is very kind and professional.
This is our favorite place, that's why we bring our dog here. :) After a daycare, mental and physical fatigue is guaranteed.
Lizy was very happy even after several days of boarding 🙂 She also loves daycare. I can only recommend it 🙂 …
Wonderful place, with knowledgeable staff. It's reassuring to bring my dog ​​here. 🐕 …

Due to a sudden family event, we had to look for a reliable place for our dog because he couldn't come with us. They were able to take our dog in right away, they are very kind, they do their job well, they have a real dog paradise. I can only recommend them. 🥰 …
Very nice team, it's obvious that they care about dogs, and the service is also reasonably priced.
The place is very cozy and the pastries are delicious.

Berlin goes to daycare here every week and has even slept in the boarding house a few times. He always loves being here, he loves all the employees :))) they pay a lot of attention to the dogs, they post a lot of Facebook stories, so we can always leave Berlin here with peace of mind. We know that at the end of the day we will get a happy and tired dog back! I can only recommend it to everyone 🫶

I can only recommend them! My puppy loves going here, the girls are very kind and knowledgeable. I really like that I can see in the daily stories how well my puppy feels at their place. We have also used the boarding house, I am extremely satisfied, I entrust my puppy to them with a calm heart. :)

This is the 3rd boarding house we have tried and it was definitely our best experience with them. Our very fearful rescued dog wanted to go back after his first trial day, the second and third time he went in to his "buddies" voluntarily and singing. Huge area, attentive and competent caretakers, many happy dogs with whom he can play and run around in the yard all day, this is paradise for Ropi! And what we like the most is the many videos and pictures that they post on Facebook during the day about the little guests, so we saw every day how well our dog was doing while we were away. We will definitely bring him here from now on if we have to travel.

Fantastic large and shady place for dogs, full of trees and with paddling pools. Clean, cultured place with new kennels, where they can relax safely. Super nice, attentive caretakers!!!! We always trust them with our dogs with a good heart!
